_what_this_is: Adversarial regressions for the one-time genesis authority and for semantic competence.
Genesis exists because the PR that rewrites the trust root cannot be certified by that
trust root. These mutations attack the properties that make it a real authority: an
out-of-band human anchor, a content-addressed verifier, an exactly-one-commit scope, and

defects.why: The candidate could silently edit the very verifier that certifies its new trust root.
A genesis manifest the human never approved could authorize the trust-root rewrite.
The one-time genesis exception could be carried silently onto a later commit.

defects.find: require(not missing, "trust-root files present at the candidate but unlisted: "
defects.replace: require(True, "trust-root files present at the candidate but unlisted: "
defects.why: A new authority file could be smuggled into the genesis trust root without human review.

defects.find: require(digest(blob(head, path)) == recorded, f"trust-root file does not match: {path}")
defects.replace: require(True, f"trust-root file does not match: {path}")
defects.why: Genesis could certify a trust root whose files differ from the ones a human approved.

defects.find: require(caught == total, f"observed {family} let a mutation escape")
defects.replace: require(True, f"observed {family} let a mutation escape")
defects.why: Genesis could be authorized on evidence in which trust-root mutations escaped.

defects.find: require(auth.get("one_time") is True, "genesis authorization is not marked one-time")
defects.replace: require(True, "genesis authorization is not marked one-time")
defects.why: The genesis exception would stop being explicitly one-time human authorization.

defects.find: if not (args.expect_verifier and args.expect_manifest and args.expect_candidate):
defects.replace: if False and not (args.expect_verifier and args.expect_manifest and args.expect_candidate):
defects.why: The out-of-band human anchor could be omitted entirely, leaving the candidate to certify itself.
The factory's own detector tests could be weakened by an ordinary PR without tripping the trust-root guard.
An authority could certify a claim it is never shown the artifacts for: independent, but not competent.
